title: High-Throughput AI-Driven Microscope Data Analysis Planform
content: The practical implementation of automatic microscope image analysis was restricted by robustness and accuracy as hand-crafted method trend to narrow down the application scenarios and generalizability. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision (CV) have empowered unprecedented image processing and analyzing capabilities by learning from raw data directly together with features discovery, refining, and combination. As a result, a certain level of intelligence is achieved by neural network that enable computer to recognize images, and give the answer of two fundamental tasks: what is the category of image (classification), and what object inside the image (segmentation). Benefit from advantages of AI & CV, a general microscope data process planform is built to perform automatic image analysis with the aim of both efficiency and accuracy manner (Fig. 1a). Novelty, an attention algorithm is developed in this work to achieve area of interest (AOI) feature extraction automatically.
